sarees.name: Kanchipuram Pure Mulberry Silk Crimson Gold Saree
sarees.certification: Silk Mark Certified 100% Pure Natural Silk
sarees.description: Handwoven on authentic floor-frame pit looms over 28 days, this heirloom Kanjivaram features traditional korvai interlocking joinery between the crimson body and deep gold pallu.
sarees.craftsmanship: Hand-loomed with 3-ply twisted silk threads and tested silver-gold zari.
sarees.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Store wrapped in pure unbleached muslin fabric.

sarees.name: Varanasi Katan Silk Kadwa Brocade Saree
sarees.color: Royal Emerald Green & Sona Rupa Zari
sarees.pattern: Jaal Work with Floral Bel & Paisley
sarees.description: Exquisite Banarasi Katan silk saree woven in the intricate Kadwa technique where each floral motif is individually hand-picked and woven into the fabric without any loose threads at the back.
sarees.craftsmanship: Woven with double-twisted Katan silk yarn and dual-tone gold & silver (Sona Rupa) zari.
sarees.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Avoid spraying perfumes directly on zari work.

sarees.name: Hand-Painted Floral Sheer Organza Silk Saree
sarees.pattern: Hand-painted Botanical Peonies with Zardozi Borders
sarees.description: Ethereal translucent silk organza saree painted by master artisans using organic mineral dyes, finished with delicate hand-stitched sequin and zari scallops.
sarees.craftsmanship: Pure silk organza weave with hand-brush stroke painting.
sarees.careInstructions: Specialist dry clean only. Iron on mild setting with protective cloth.

sarees.name: Yeola Handwoven Paithani Silk Peacock Saree
sarees.description: Royal Maharashtra Paithani saree featuring a tapestry-woven zari pallu depicting peacocks perched amidst flowering branches. Reversible tapestry weave with no float threads.
sarees.craftsmanship: Woven with pure gold-plated zari thread and fine mulberry silk warp.
sarees.careInstructions: Dry clean only. Preserve in soft cotton cloth.

sarees.name: Chanderi Tissue Silk Cotton Saree with Gold Ashrafi
sarees.description: Featherweight Chanderi tissue saree woven with silk warp and mercerized cotton weft, adorned with coin booti woven using traditional hand-guided needles.
sarees.craftsmanship: Handspun silk-cotton yarn with gold metallic thread insertion.

sarees.name: Wild Tussar Ghicha Silk Kantha Stitch Saree
sarees.description: Raw unrefined Tussar silk saree adorned with thousands of hand-embroidered running stitches forming village folklore scenes along the pallu.
sarees.craftsmanship: 100% hand-stitched Kantha embroidery on wild forest silk.
